name: Suspicious curl/wget Download to Staging Directory or Piped to Shell
description: Detects curl or wget fetching a URL and either piping the response directly into a shell interpreter or saving it into a common malware-staging directory (/tmp, /dev/shm), a common living-off-the-land download-and-execute pattern. Linux analog of the certutil download rule. Source: detections/rules/proc_creation_lnx_curl_download_exec.yml, hand-converted from Sigma (no ecs_linux/auditd pysigma pipeline exists, so this EQL targets the real auditbeat auditd-module field shape directly).
query: any where process.executable like~ ("*/curl", "*/wget") and process.title like~ ("*http://*", "*https://*") and process.title like~ ("*| bash*", "*|bash*", "*| sh*", "*|sh*", "*/tmp/*", "*/dev/shm/*")
false_positives: Legitimate install scripts (e.g. vendor "curl | bash" installers) or CI jobs staging build artifacts in /tmp
author: Sentinel
